$comment: Portfolio pilot dashboard (PostHog EU). Create each insight as SQL (HogQL) in PostHog after sign-up; names and KPI IDs follow docs/measurement/KPI-PLAN.md. Guardrails KPI-G-01..G-03 live outside PostHog (link audit, catalog tests, Sentry).

query.query: SELECT event, count() AS events, max(timestamp) AS last_seen FROM events WHERE properties.product = 'portfolio' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY event ORDER BY events DESC

insights.name: KPI-O-01 Contact messages delivered per month

query.query: SELECT toStartOfMonth(timestamp) AS month, countIf(event = 'contact_sent') AS contact_messages, countIf(event = 'contact_sent' AND properties.locale = 'th') AS thai FROM events WHERE properties.product = 'portfolio' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 12 MONTH GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

insights.name: KPI-L-01 Case-study views per consented visit
insights.min_volume: 200 consented visits per week, else not measurable

query.query: SELECT toStartOfWeek(timestamp) AS week, uniqIf(`$session_id`, event = '$pageview') AS visits, countIf(event = 'view_project') AS project_views, if(visits >= 200, round(project_views / visits, 2), NULL) AS views_per_visit FROM events WHERE properties.product = 'portfolio' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 12 WEEK GROUP BY week ORDER BY week

insights.name: KPI-L-02 Demo / source click-through from a case study
insights.min_volume: 100 project views per week, else not measurable

query.query: SELECT toStartOfWeek(timestamp) AS week, countIf(event = 'view_project') AS project_views, countIf(event IN ('click_demo', 'click_source')) AS clicks, if(project_views >= 100, round(100 * clicks / project_views, 1), NULL) AS click_through_pct FROM events WHERE properties.product = 'portfolio' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 12 WEEK GROUP BY week ORDER BY week
